Name: CampfireCooking
Author: KabigonFirst
Description:
[b]Campfire Cooking[/b]

Before you upgrade your house, it's embarrassing that you cannot cook. This mode add cooking function to campfire. Happy cooking with campfire!
By default, only campfire can be accessed when light it on but you can config to add more ﻿"cookable" objects.
For SDV 1.3, ﻿"cookable" objects could be fireplaces, brazier and campfire. Any action key can access the objects.
For SDV 1.2, fireplaces are not supported, brazier and campfire are supported. And the keys to access "cookable" objects is limited to X key or right-click.

[b]Compatibility[/b]

This mod is compatible with SMAPI 2.0+ and any other SMAPI mod if the key settings are not conflict.

[b]Install[/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install SMAPI[/url] 2.0+.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]modify key binding setting if necessary.
[/list][b]Source Code[/b]
